SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS documents,COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT OrderID) AS distinct_documents,MIN(OrderDate) AS min_date,MAX(OrderDate) AS max_date,SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN pick_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bigint)) AS current_pending_or_unobserved,SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN pick_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bigint)) AS current_completed_flag,SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN pick_at<CAST(OrderDate AS datetime2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bigint)) AS pick_before_order FROM (SELECT o.OrderID,o.OrderDate,o.PickingCompletedWhen AS pick_at,o.LastEditedWhen AS edited_at,
    o.BackorderOrderID,COALESCE(p.parents,0) AS parent_count,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.parents,0)>1 THEN 'ambiguous_lineage'
      WHEN p.parents IS NOT NULL AND o.BackorderOrderID IS NOT NULL THEN 'derived_with_backorder'
      WHEN p.parents IS NOT NULL THEN 'derived_terminal'
      WHEN o.BackorderOrderID IS NOT NULL THEN 'original_with_backorder'
      ELSE 'original_without_backorder' END AS cohort,
    DATEADD(day,3,CAST(o.OrderDate AS datetime2)) AS horizon_end,
    CASE WHEN o.OrderDate<'20150101' THEN CAST('20150101' AS datetime2) ELSE CAST('20160101' AS datetime2) END AS cutoff
    FROM Sales.Orders o LEFT JOIN (SELECT BackorderOrderID,COUNT_BIG(*) AS parents FROM Sales.Orders WHERE BackorderOrderID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY BackorderOrderID) p ON o.OrderID=p.BackorderOrderID
    WHERE o.OrderDate < ?) q

SELECT CONVERT(char(7),OrderDate,126) AS month,cohort,state,COUNT_BIG(*) AS documents FROM (SELECT b.*,CASE WHEN OrderDate IS NULL OR pick_at<CAST(OrderDate AS datetime2) THEN 'invalid'
    WHEN horizon_end>cutoff THEN 'insufficient_followup'
    WHEN pick_at IS NULL THEN 'missing_pick_indeterminate'
    WHEN pick_at>=cutoff THEN 'pick_not_observed_by_cut'
    WHEN edited_at IS NULL OR edited_at>=cutoff THEN 'row_not_available_by_cut'
    WHEN CAST(pick_at AS date)>DATEADD(day,2,OrderDate) THEN 'after_two_days'
    ELSE 'within_two_days' END AS state FROM (SELECT o.OrderID,o.OrderDate,o.PickingCompletedWhen AS pick_at,o.LastEditedWhen AS edited_at,
    o.BackorderOrderID,COALESCE(p.parents,0) AS parent_count,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.parents,0)>1 THEN 'ambiguous_lineage'
      WHEN p.parents IS NOT NULL AND o.BackorderOrderID IS NOT NULL THEN 'derived_with_backorder'
      WHEN p.parents IS NOT NULL THEN 'derived_terminal'
      WHEN o.BackorderOrderID IS NOT NULL THEN 'original_with_backorder'
      ELSE 'original_without_backorder' END AS cohort,
    DATEADD(day,3,CAST(o.OrderDate AS datetime2)) AS horizon_end,
    CASE WHEN o.OrderDate<'20150101' THEN CAST('20150101' AS datetime2) ELSE CAST('20160101' AS datetime2) END AS cutoff
    FROM Sales.Orders o LEFT JOIN (SELECT BackorderOrderID,COUNT_BIG(*) AS parents FROM Sales.Orders WHERE BackorderOrderID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY BackorderOrderID) p ON o.OrderID=p.BackorderOrderID
    WHERE o.OrderDate < ?) b) q GROUP BY CONVERT(char(7),OrderDate,126),cohort,state ORDER BY month,cohort,state

SELECT cohort,COUNT_BIG(*) AS documents FROM (SELECT o.OrderID,o.OrderDate,o.PickingCompletedWhen AS pick_at,o.LastEditedWhen AS edited_at,
    o.BackorderOrderID,COALESCE(p.parents,0) AS parent_count,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.parents,0)>1 THEN 'ambiguous_lineage'
      WHEN p.parents IS NOT NULL AND o.BackorderOrderID IS NOT NULL THEN 'derived_with_backorder'
      WHEN p.parents IS NOT NULL THEN 'derived_terminal'
      WHEN o.BackorderOrderID IS NOT NULL THEN 'original_with_backorder'
      ELSE 'original_without_backorder' END AS cohort,
    DATEADD(day,3,CAST(o.OrderDate AS datetime2)) AS horizon_end,
    CASE WHEN o.OrderDate<'20150101' THEN CAST('20150101' AS datetime2) ELSE CAST('20160101' AS datetime2) END AS cutoff
    FROM Sales.Orders o LEFT JOIN (SELECT BackorderOrderID,COUNT_BIG(*) AS parents FROM Sales.Orders WHERE BackorderOrderID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY BackorderOrderID) p ON o.OrderID=p.BackorderOrderID

SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS edges,SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN c.OrderID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bigint)) AS orphan_child,SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN c.OrderDate<>o.OrderDate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bigint)) AS different_dates,SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN c.OrderID<=o.OrderID THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bigint)) AS non_increasing_ids FROM Sales.Orders o LEFT JOIN Sales.Orders c ON c.OrderID=o.BackorderOrderID WHERE o.OrderDate < ? AND o.BackorderOrderID IS NOT NULL

SELECT cohort,DATEDIFF(day,OrderDate,CAST(pick_at AS date)) AS days_to_pick,COUNT_BIG(*) AS documents FROM (SELECT o.OrderID,o.OrderDate,o.PickingCompletedWhen AS pick_at,o.LastEditedWhen AS edited_at,
    o.BackorderOrderID,COALESCE(p.parents,0) AS parent_count,
